sources.entry: Slate – AI-powered interactive learning platform. Generate a course on any topic and learn with AI classmates who ask questions, test your understanding, and adapt to your pace.

summary.name: Slate Up
summary.one_liner: Slate Up is an AI-powered interactive classroom that generates a personalised course with slides, narration and AI classmates from any topic a user types.
use_cases: learning a new topic from a single prompt
learning programming or science topics interactively
summary.what_it_does: Users type any topic and the platform generates a classroom lesson with slides, narration and a set of six AI characters, which the page describes as classmates who ask questions, take notes, joke and dig deeper. The page says generation takes under 30 seconds. Lessons can be paced by the learner, replayed and revisited. The page also mentions personalised explanations, adaptive courses and instant doubt resolution. It offers a walkthrough for teams that want to see the product for their students.
notable: Generates a full slide-and-narration course from any topic in under 30 seconds
Six AI classmate characters with distinct roles such as questioner, note-taker and joker
Lessons can be replayed and paced by the learner
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Demo content is loaded in the page and the page does not describe limits on topics or usage
